deleteConfirmation.confirmDelete: What would you like to do with
deleteConfirmation.permanentDeleteNotice: Deleting permanently moves the session (with its history) to Recently Deleted, where the project owner can restore it during the retention period. Only the project owner or an administrator can delete permanently.
deleteConfirmation.archiveSessionNotice: Archive keeps the session out of the active list while preserving its history.
deleteConfirmation.archivedSessionNotice: This session is already archived. You can keep it hidden or delete it permanently.
deleteConfirmation.cannotDeletePermanently: You are not this project's owner, so you can only archive it — archiving hides it from the active list and keeps every message.
deleteConfirmation.archivedAndCannotDelete: This session is already archived. Only the project owner or an administrator can delete it permanently, so there is nothing to do here.
deleteConfirmation.cannotRemoveProject: You are not this project's owner — archiving or deleting a whole project is limited to its owner and administrators. You can still archive your own sessions.

bulk.archiveExplain: Archive: only hides them from the active list. You can restore them from Archived at any time; nothing is deleted.
bulk.deleteExplain: Delete all data: removes the session history and attachment folders of the selected projects (projects: {{projectCount}}; sessions in total: {{sessionCount}}). This cannot be undone. The project folders and the code in them are not deleted.
bulk.permissionsNote: Only projects you own (or every project, for root) are changed; the rest are skipped and listed in the result.
bulk.noOwnerNote: With “No owner”, a project is visible to everyone only if it lives under the public directory (PRISM_PUBLIC_WORKSPACE); otherwise only root can see it. This change is recorded in the audit log.
